summary: H-014B frontend-only verification. Logged in via /login demo-homeowner quick button (alex@stratexhabitat.com), redirected to /twin, SPA-navigated via left-nav 'Reality Studio (Dev)' to /reality-foundation. Verified tabbed shell (reality-studio-page) with both tabs, no-regression on Reference Room (H-014A) tab, and full governed capture proof render on Capture Review (H-014B) tab. All 33 assertions passed. Loading state ('reality-capture-loading') was observed on tab mount before the ~1-3s server round-trip resolved to the dashboard. Read-only enforced (0 button/input/textarea/select elements inside reality-capture-page). Tab toggle back to Reference Room re-renders H-014A content and unmounts capture page.
critical_code_review_comments: RealityStudioFoundation.js:456 — tab state is local to the page component so switching tabs re-mounts each view, causing the capture-proof bootstrap POST to re-run on every tab switch. Consider caching the response or hoisting state so the ~1-3s round-trip is not repeated needlessly.
RealityStudioFoundation.js:169 — Row for `em.version` renders raw value without a fallback (`v={em.version}`), unlike sibling rows using `|| '—'`. Cosmetic parity issue.

RealityStudioFoundation.js:387 — CandidateExistingModel panel wires `entity_count` from top-level `data.entity_count` rather than `cand.entity_count`. Currently harmless because both fields equal 12, but if the two ever diverge the candidate panel will silently show the wrong number.
